opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low‑income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland, not eligible for public tuition fee support, enrolled in an undergraduate degree at a Scottish Institute of Higher Education, meeting income thresholds and other criteria outlined in the applicant guide.
opportunities.summary: Grants cover tuition fees up to £1,820 per year for eligible undergraduate students in academic year 2026‑27.
